title: Infrastructure Engineering Intern – Backup & Disaster Recovery
desc:
At Eclit, we offer managed IT services that meet the end-to-end IT needs of businesses of all sizes with our self-developed technology platforms through Turkey's largest and most reliable cloud infrastructure.
With more than 20 years of experience, we are an industry-leading technology company. We simplify the complex structure of IT with our vision of setting the standards of the managed services industry in Turkey, our expert human resources and technological infrastructure.
Join us to be a part of this dynamic team and share our goal of taking technology to the next level with creative solutions!
What You Will Do
Monitor backup job results and help report successful and failed jobs
Participate in routine checks of disaster recovery solutions, such as Zerto and RP4VM, alongside experienced team members
Assist in monitoring system performance and capacity data
Learn basic troubleshooting steps and help resolve straightforward issues under the guidance of team members
Help collect data during technical investigations and root cause analysis
Run prebuilt PowerShell and vCLI scripts under supervision
Help track software and hardware updates
Who You Are
You are a 3rd- or 4th-year student pursuing a degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field
You are interested in infrastructure technologies, backup, and disaster recovery
You are eager to develop foundational knowledge of operating systems, server environments, and virtualization
You enjoy researching, asking questions, and sharing what you learn
You have strong organizational and follow-up skills and pay close attention to detail
You communicate effectively within a team and are willing to take responsibility
You have a good command of English
What Awaits You
A hands-on environment where you can take ownership and contribute to real-world projects
End-to-end exposure to the world of managed services
Continuous learning and development with mentorship from experienced engineers
A dynamic, agile, and collaborative work environment
Competitive salary
